name: plan_submit
description:
Present the plan written with plan_write for approval — only in plan mode, and only once the plan is written.

- The user approves it (and you continue, now allowed to make the changes), asks for a revision (change the plan with plan_write or plan_update, then call plan_submit again), or asks you a question (answer it, then call plan_submit again).

path.description: Ignored: the plan is the one written with plan_write. Kept for callers that still send it.
